territory.msg.hint: Each spot is colored by its nearest store's brand. Drag to pan, scroll to zoom.
territory.msg.sample: Sample only — OSM lists roughly a third of the real stores, so your block may be missing one.
territory.msg.districtHint: Hovering one district — these numbers are precomputed. Leave the map to go back to the on-screen view.
territory.msg.electionHint: Winner takes the whole district. Deeper color means a wider margin; pale means a close race.
